Chapter 702 - 702 Killing The Enemy With A Single Finger; Curse

Chapter 702 - 702 Killing the Enemy With a Single Finger; Curse

702 Killing the Enemy With a Single Finger; Curse

Xing Yu’s body froze as he looked at Lin Fan warily.

After all, Lin Fan had suddenly appeared in the Chaosverse.

This meant that he was at least in the Planet level.

This needed to be handled carefully.

Otherwise, it would be very easy to fail miserably.

“I’m Xing Yu, a disciple of the Sky Thunder Sect. How should I address you?” Xing Yu asked.

“Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

Xing Yu frowned.

Lin Fan’s self-introduction was too short.

It was a little disrespectful.

[Ding! Xing Yu’s hatred toward you is one star.]

Lin Fan raised his brows and looked at Xing Yu with an even more hostile gaze.

Attacking Earth and even generating hatred points toward him…

This guy was walking on a narrow path.

Xing Yu said, “I wonder why you’re here, Lin Fan?”

Lin Fan said, “Xing Yu, let’s not beat about the bush. The rock you just attacked was the planet I was on.

“It’s just that I used a special technique to shrink and defend it. Don’t attack anymore, or you’ll be an enemy of my planet.”

Xing Yu said in a doubtful tone, “Is that a planet?”

He had never seen or heard of a planet that could shrink and possess such powerful defense.

Lin Fan nodded. “That’s right.”

Xing Yu’s eyes darted around. “So, it’s your planet. I didn’t know about it before, so I was rude.”

After a pause, he said in a very friendly tone, “Lin Fan, I wonder if I can visit your planet?”

He did not believe that this rock with a strong defense was a planet.

In his opinion, this was very likely a mysterious forbidden land or a magic treasure with spatial power.

Of course, even if it was really a planet, it would definitely have a huge secret and a huge opportunity!

Xing Yu’s idea was simple. As long as he entered, he would be able to take it for himself.

Lin Fan shook his head. “Our planet is weak. That’s why we’ve always been in a sealed state. We don’t allow outsiders to enter.”

Xing Yu frowned and said, “Lin Fan, are you looking down on me?”

At the same time, he was more and more certain that there was a big secret in this stone.

The greed in his eyes when he looked at Earth grew even more intense. The way he looked at Lin Fan became even more unfriendly.

Xing Yu thought to himself, ‘If this rock is really Lin Fan’s planet, then if I kill him or capture him, will I be able to enter it?”

Once this thought appeared, it was like burning gasoline. It burned more and more vigorously.

From the moment he saw Lin Fan, he had been sizing up Lin Fan’s cultivation.

By now, Xing Yu was certain that Lin Fan’s cultivation state was about the same as his.

He had many tricks up his sleeves and was confident that he could defeat or even kill Lin Fan.

[Ding! Xing Yu’s hatred toward you has increased to five stars.]

Lin Fan raised his brows and did not say anything else. He stared at Xing Yu with his Eye of Heaven.

In an instant…

All of Xing Yu’s attacks, weaknesses, defense, treasures, and even his life-saving techniques appeared in Lin Fan’s mind.

Lin Fan raised his hand and pointed.

Golden light burst forth from his finger, and thousands of terrifying energy forces burst forth like a tidal wave, drowning Xing Yu in an instant.

In the blink of an eye, Xing Yu and everything within a radius of tens of thousands of kilometers were reduced to nothingness.

“Heaven Piercing Finger!”

[Ding! Your enemy, Xing Yu, is dead.]

With one finger, he instantly killed a Domain Lord!

This was the Lin Fan of today. This was how strong he was!

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-one Domain Lord cultivator. You’ve gained ten million experience.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’re the first to kill a Domain Lord cultivator. You’ve received a Transcendence Golden Body x1 and Top Grade Fire Cultivation Talent.]

Lin Fan could feel a pure energy surging into his limbs.

Following that, his affinity with the Fire Laws became even greater.

Lin Fan and the Transcendence Golden Body that had just formed looked at each other and smiled.

In other words, while Earth was in trouble, he had gained a lot of benefits.

Lin Fan was in a good mood as he leaped up and returned to Earth.

He said to Hu Tian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Su Ningjing, Han Tian, and the others who were standing in the Coiling Dragon Villa, “It’s fine now.”

Hearing this, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, they began to cultivate even more attentively.

They believed that Lin Fan was strong enough, and they admired and liked him.

However, they did not want Lin Fan to be the one to solve every problem.

They wanted to help Lin Fan.

…

On a distant planet.

In a towering building filled with spiritual energy, a man with sword-like eyebrows suddenly opened his eyes. His entire face was filled with endless anger.

“What? Xing Yu is dead?”

“Who? Who killed him?!”

This man was Xing Baokun, the peak master of Sky Thunder Sect’s Flying Peak and Xing Yu’s father.

Xing Baokun had doted on Xing Yu since he was young.

When he discovered Xing Yu’s talent in cultivation, he spent a great deal of effort on him.

But now… Xing Yu was dead!

How could this not anger Xing Baokun?

“Investigate! Investigate Xing Yu’s whereabouts and the people who have a grudge against him! I want to know who killed him!”

His voice reverberated around the mountain, causing the entire mountain to shake.

At the same time, all the disciples of the sect were shocked.

All the disciples knew how much Xing Baokun loved Xing Yu.

The sky had collapsed!

…

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Xing Baokun’s hatred toward you is seven stars.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his brows twitched.

Seven-star hatred, this was definitely a huge enemy.

[Xing Baokun: Level-Two Universe cultivator. The peak master of Sky Thunder Sect’s Flying Peak. Because you killed his son and disciple Xing Yu, he has developed a great hatred for you.]

So it was Xing Yu’s father. No wonder.

Level-Two Universe cultivator!

Even though Lin Fan had the Eye of Heaven and many other powerful skills, he still felt that he was no match for him.

The difference in cultivation between the two was simply too great.

He had to think of a way to save himself.

Lin Fan quickly turned his attention back to Curse.

[Do you want to use 10,000 spirit stones to curse Xing Baokun?]

“Yes!”

However, there was no notification of Xing Baokun being cursed in Lin Fan’s mind.

Perhaps the other party was too powerful.

Hence, Lin Fan was prepared to curse Xing Baokun even harder.

However, at this moment, a notification sounded in his mind.

[Curse can only be used once a day.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could only give up for now. From now on, he was prepared to curse Xing Baokun every day until he died.

Death was the best ending for the enemy.
